scoringRubrics.description: Correctness of technical concepts, algorithms, syntax, architectural reasoning, and domain depth.

bands.exceptional_9_10: Flawless technical correctness, covers edge cases, nuances, and internal workings.
bands.proficient_7_8: Accurate concepts with minor omissions of low-impact details.
bands.developing_5_6: Basic understanding present, but contains conceptual gaps or slight inaccuracies.
bands.inadequate_1_4: Incorrect information, fundamental misunderstanding, or failure to answer the core technical question.

scoringRubrics.description: Direct alignment with the prompt without off-topic filler, evasion, or generic generalizations.

bands.exceptional_9_10: Pinpoint focus on the question with zero filler or evasive language.
bands.proficient_7_8: Addresses all core parts of the question directly.
bands.developing_5_6: Somewhat tangential or addresses only part of a multi-part prompt.
bands.inadequate_1_4: Completely off-topic or fails to answer the question asked.

scoringRubrics.description: Logical sequencing, structured communication, conciseness, and precise terminology.

bands.exceptional_9_10: Superbly structured (e.g. top-down, STAR, or architectural flow), clear, concise, and easy to follow.
bands.proficient_7_8: Well-organized with clear progression of ideas.
bands.inadequate_1_4: Incoherent, difficult to parse, or contradictory.

scoringRubrics.description: Coverage of edge cases, trade-offs, real-world examples, and measurable results.

bands.exceptional_9_10: Thorough coverage of trade-offs, failure modes, scale constraints, and concrete examples.
bands.proficient_7_8: Covers primary solution and at least one trade-off or real-world example.

scoringRubrics.description: Articulate delivery, professional tone, confidence, and stakeholder awareness.

bands.exceptional_9_10: Executive-level communication, confident, professional, and engaging.
bands.proficient_7_8: Clear professional demeanor and appropriate tone.
bands.developing_5_6: Hesitant, colloquial, or overly informal tone.
